entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating demographic membership as an identity driver or assuming a salient identity has one fixed behavioral implication.
entities.definition: The degree to which performing a specified behavior is represented as part of who the person is.
entities.evidenceNotes: Scientifically defensible with substantial supporting literature, while causal identification, construct boundaries, measurement, or transferability remain context dependent. Representative records: SRC194; SRC130.
entities.measurementAssessmentMethods: Validated identity scales; salience manipulations; narrative or content coding; experience sampling
entities.measurementCaveats: Identity is multidimensional and context-sensitive; group labels do not reveal identification strength, content, or fusion.
entities.mechanism: Increases value and consistency pressure for identity-congruent action.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Identity content, context, competing identities, group norms, threat intensity, culture, and perceived efficacy.
entities.name: Behavioral Self-Identity
entities.persistenceRecovery: Salience changes quickly; centrality and fusion may persist for months or years and can be path-dependent.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = stronger incorporation of the behavior into self-concept.

entities.commonMisinterpretations: Treating demographic membership as an identity driver or assuming a salient identity has one fixed behavioral implication.
entities.definition: The intensity of aversive inconsistency experienced among behavior, beliefs, attitudes, commitments, or self-concept.
entities.evidenceNotes: Supported by established theory, validated measures, and converging review, meta-analytic, experimental, or longitudinal evidence. Magnitude and behavioral direction remain conditional on context. Representative records: SRC127; SRC196.
entities.measurementAssessmentMethods: Validated identity scales; salience manipulations; narrative or content coding; experience sampling
entities.measurementCaveats: Identity is multidimensional and context-sensitive; group labels do not reveal identification strength, content, or fusion.
entities.mechanism: Motivates change in attitudes, beliefs, behavior, or interpretation to reduce inconsistency.
entities.moderatorsBoundaryConditions: Identity content, context, competing identities, group norms, threat intensity, culture, and perceived efficacy.
entities.name: Dissonance Magnitude
entities.persistenceRecovery: Usually reversible as cues, resources, or interpretations change; repeated appraisal can stabilize.
entities.polarityDirection: Higher values = greater experienced inconsistency and discomfort.
entities.representationScale: None–high dissonance; discrepancy and discomfort ratings
